experience.headline: A software and QA foundation for reliable operations.

items.text: Designs reusable data processes and automates recurring workflows across Salesforce/Nimble AMS and connected marketing, membership, event, finance, and reporting systems. Translates business rules into SQL/SOQL logic, builds audience-generation and integration workflows, and supports legacy CRM migration through validation, reconciliation, and exception handling. Develops reporting and data-quality monitoring for Marketing, Membership, Sales, Finance, and Operations, taking on increasingly complex technical work from defining rules through testing outputs and monitoring recurring issues.

Developed SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, automation, data-transfer processes, and user-facing applications supporting internal operational workflows. Built repeatable data processes that reduced manual work and improved maintainability.

roles.text: Advanced from volunteer contributor to paid QA and live-operations support. Performed regression and pre-release testing, reproduced defects, investigated unexpected system behavior, validated fixes, and documented actionable findings for developers. This work established the troubleshooting mindset I now apply to data and operational analysis.

Tested game systems, reproduced technical issues, validated data consistency, and documented defects with clear reproduction steps. Earned additional responsibility through dependable testing, communication, and follow-through.

capabilities.headline: Reliable data. Repeatable processes. Better decisions.
capabilities.intro: Three kinds of business-data problems I repeatedly solve, with examples of the processes, validation, and analysis behind the work.

categories.title: Business Data Systems & Automation
categories.intro: Designing repeatable data workflows that translate business rules into automated processes across CRM, marketing, reporting, and operational systems.

examples.title: Magazine Circulation Automation
examples.summary: Combined membership, affiliation, exhibitor, registration, geographic, request, and exception rules into a recurring audience-generation process.
impact: Reduced manual audience assembly.
Standardized circulation rules and reduced recipient-error risk.
Simplified future publication cycles.

steps: Bring membership, affiliation, exhibitor, registration, and request data into a repeatable preparation workflow.
Translate inclusion, geographic, and exception rules into reusable query and Power Query logic.
Validate the resulting audience against business rules and reconcile exceptions before preparing the publication file.
Reuse the workflow for the next publication cycle, updating source inputs and rules as needed.

examples.title: Enterprise Email Suppression Governance
examples.summary: Centralized fragmented suppression and exception processes into a reusable automated framework for email audience eligibility.
impact: Reduced manual exception maintenance.
Improved consistency across email programs.
Created scalable governance and monitoring for audience eligibility.

examples.title: Audience Generation & Segmentation
examples.summary: Built reusable Salesforce and SQL logic for audiences based on organizational relationships, membership, event participation, geography, and other business criteria. Applied validation to finance audiences, helping pause and rebuild inaccurate payment reminders before sending.
impact: Reduced one-off audience preparation.
Improved targeting consistency through reusable segmentation rules.
Reduced the risk of stale reminders reaching recently paid customers.

examples.title: Event Data Integration
examples.summary: Built ingestion and transformation processes for exhibitor, registration, membership, and related event data used by marketing and operations.
impact: Reduced manual data preparation.
Improved consistency of event datasets.
Supported recurring downstream marketing and operational workflows.

categories.title: CRM Data Quality & Migration
categories.intro: Validating and reconciling CRM data across migrations, relationships, and recurring business processes so downstream systems can rely on it.

examples.title: Legacy CRM to Salesforce Migration
examples.summary: Supported migration and validation of business data from the legacy CRM into Salesforce while learning the new platform and associated business processes.
impact: Validated record counts and reconciled relationships across systems.
Investigated transformation discrepancies and handled exceptions.
Supported migration QA with repeatable comparisons.

examples.title: Council Affiliation Reconciliation
examples.summary: Designed matching and reconciliation logic for council-affiliation migration, working through historical relationship conflicts and merged-record exceptions.
impact: Improved record matching with unique lookup keys.
Resolved relationship and import exceptions through iterative testing.
Validated affiliations before and after import.

steps: Compare legacy and Salesforce relationships and build unique lookup keys for matching affiliation records.
Reconcile historical relationship conflicts and merged-record exceptions against source data.
Test imports iteratively and use verified examples to investigate and resolve import errors.
Validate record counts and relationships before and after import to check the reconciliation results.

examples.title: Membership Flowdown Integrity
examples.summary: Investigated recurring relationship failures across Salesforce/Nimble AMS using SQL/SOQL analysis and business-rule investigation. Tracked new issues over time and helped identify underlying relationship-configuration problems.
impact: Made recurring failures visible through repeatable monitoring.
Helped distinguish configuration issues from isolated record errors.
Documented root-cause findings to support corrective work.

examples.title: Data Quality Audit Framework
examples.summary: Created recurring validation for missing primary contacts, invalid or unreachable email records, relationship inconsistencies, and duplicate or questionable records. One reachability audit identified organizations without an assigned primary contact.
impact: Turned contactability gaps into actionable review findings.
Made operational risks consistently reviewable with severity thresholds.
Tracked findings over time through reusable checks and historical logging.

categories.title: Analytics & Decision Support
categories.intro: Turning operational and historical data into analysis that helps teams understand customers, performance, risk, and future outcomes.

examples.title: Historical Exhibitor Analysis
examples.summary: Built historical exhibitor analysis to identify first-time and returning organizations by determining when businesses first exhibited.
impact: Provided historical context for sales conversations.
Supported lifecycle and retention analysis.
Enabled first-time exhibitor targeting and historical trend analysis.

examples.title: Membership Retention & Revenue Forecasting
examples.summary: Built models estimating future revenue impact under different membership renewal and attrition scenarios.
impact: Improved visibility into renewal trends.
Supported planning discussions with scenario estimates.
Created repeatable forecasting logic.

examples.title: Reporting Modernization
examples.summary: Automated recurring reports that previously required extraction, reconciliation, and manual preparation.
impact: Reduced recurring manual effort.
Improved report consistency and reduced error risk.
Enabled more frequent reporting.

examples.title: Engagement Analytics
examples.summary: Developed analysis of council, network, email, and audience engagement to help business teams understand participation and activity.
impact: Made participation and activity patterns easier to understand.
Provided context for audience and engagement decisions.
